name: Bone-Bladed Weapons

faq.answer: Jes'rimon is a craftsman and broker in Orgrimmar who fashions weapons for demanding clients.
Jes'rimon requires eight white ravasaur claws to craft goods for his buyers.
Jes'rimon uses the claws to fashion bone-bladed weapons for his impatient buyers.
faq.q: What are the claws used for?

aliases: where to turn in bone-bladed weapons
faq.answer: Jes'rimon awaits the claws within the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.

sections.body: Impatient buyers have placed orders with Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar, and their patience wears thin. Procuring eight white ravasaur claws will allow him to satisfy his trade and shape deadly armaments from the beasts.
sections.title: Claws for the Forge

summary: In Orgrimmar, Jes'rimon needs eight white ravasaur claws to supply bone-bladed weapons for his waiting clients. Delivering the materials quickly earns his favor and the promise of a weapon shaped from the beast.
